title: AreaObjects
description:
Everything placed around a point of a worldspace, as the game shows
it, for looking at the place closely (ADR 0038); or everything placed
in one interior cell (ADR 0042).

actions.description:
The places where characters do something, drawn or not (ADR 0069),
in no particular order.

centre.description:
The point, in game units; for an interior cell, the middle of what
is placed in it.

objects.description: The objects, with a model, in no particular order.

radius.description: How far around the point, in game units, in each direction.

world.description:
The worldspace, by its internal name; for an interior cell, the
cell's editor ID.

ActionKind.description: What characters do at a place.

oneOf.description: Sit: a chair, a bench, a stool, a spot on the ground.
Lean against a wall, a railing or a counter.
Sleep: a bed or a bedroll.
Chop wood at a chopping block.

Work at a forge, an anvil, a smelter, a tanning rack, a grindstone
or a workbench.
Mix potions or enchant at a table.
Cook at a pot, a spit or an oven, or churn butter.
Other work: sweep, rake, farm, hammer, wash.
Stand and do something not told apart: a spot of an idle marker.

ActionPlace.description: One place where characters do something.

base.description: The internal name of what is placed, such as `WallLeanMarker`.

drawn.description:
Whether the game draws it: a chair or a forge is seen, a marker to
lean or sit on the ground is not.

idleMarker.description: Whether it is an idle marker rather than furniture.

name.description: The name players see, where there is one.

object.description:
The placed object: the plugin that placed it first and its number
there.

plugin.description: The plugin whose version the game uses.

rotation.description:
Turned about the x, y and z axes, in radians; the turn about z is
the way characters face there.

anchored.description:
Whether the game relies on it being there: it is persistent (other
things refer to it) or part of the distant view. Such an object is
not offered for hiding.

id.description: The reference: the plugin that placed it first and its number there.

model.description: Its model, below the data directory.

name.description: The name players see, or else the internal one.

plugin.description: The plugin whose version the game uses.

rotation.description: Turned about the x, y and z axes, in radians.

scale.description: The size relative to the base object.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.
